1651-2638-6751-6756-8344.easyPrerequisites: You control a land that enters the battlefield untapped and that can tap to produce at least {1}.
1651-2638-6751-6756-8344.notablePrerequisites:
Nog's second activated ability has been activated.
Hearthhull has two or more charge counters on it.
1651-2638-6751-6756-8344.description:
Activate a land by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Hearthhull by paying {1}, tapping it and sacrificing a land.
If Hearthhull has eight or more charge counters on it, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose 2 life.
Resolve the Hearthhull ability, causing you to draw two cards and allowing you to play an additional land this turn.
Play the land from your graveyard.
When the land enters the battlefield, Tireless Tracker triggers twice due to Starfield Vocalist, creating two artifact tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the artifact tokens, untapping Hearthhull.
Repeat.

2842-4279-6887--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
2842-4279-6887--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Blood Artist, The Skullspore Nexus and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Blood Artist trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the The Skullspore Nexus ability, creating a X/X Fungus creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Blood Artist triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

132-549-3053-4687.easyPrerequisites:

132-549-3053-4687.description:
Activate Myr Welder using Prismatic Geoscope's ability by tapping it, adding at least {2}{G/U}.
Activate Myr Welder using Gilder Bairn's ability by paying {2}{G/U} and untapping it, targeting any permanent.
Repeat.
132-549-3053-4687.notes: This combo only produces infinite mana if you control lands with at least four basic land types.

573-2167-4548-5721.easyPrerequisites: You control lands that can tap to produce at least {7}{G}{G}{B} (but see notes).
573-2167-4548-5721.description:
Activate Squandered Resources by sacrificing each land you control, adding at least {7}{G}{G}{B}.
Activate Aftermath Analyst by paying {3}{G} and sacrificing it, returning all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Gruul Turf enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Takenuma from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Takenuma's channel ability by paying at most {3}{B}, milling three cards and returning Aftermath Analyst from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Aftermath Analyst by paying {1}{G}.
When Aftermath Analyst enters, it triggers, causing you to mill three cards.
Repeat
573-2167-4548-5721.notes: Each legendary creature you control reduces the amount of mana required by {1}, up to a maximum of {3}. Each loop also has a chance to generate more mana than the one before it due to additional milled lands, so if you have excess mana you can begin the loop without the required number of lands and have a chance to achieve the infinite loop through milling.

851-2557-6664-7824-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and The Wandering Minstrel.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

requires.n: Instant or Sorcery that Targets a Creature and Creates Treasure
Creature that Returns an Instant or Sorcery from Graveyard to Hand on Entering

6785-7845--178--179.description:
Cast Devastating Onslaught by paying its mana cost targeting the creature that can recur spells.
When you cast that spell, Spinerock Tyrant triggers, copying Devastating Onslaught and choosing Spinerock Tyrant as its target.
Resolve the copy of Devastating Onslaught, creating a Spinerock Tyrant token.
Resolve the original Devastating Onslaught, creating a token copy of the spell recursion creature.
When that token enters, it triggers, returning Devastating Onslaught from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat from step 1 one additional time, resulting in a total of five Spinerock Tyrants.
Cast the spell that creates a Treasure token by paying its mana cost, targeting any creature.
Each copy of Spinerock Tyrant triggers, copying that spell once for each Spinerock Tyrant you control.
Resolve all copies of that spell, creating at least one Treasure token each time.
Activate those Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding one mana per Treasure.
Cast Devastating Onslaught by paying its mana cost targeting the spell recursion creature.
When you cast that spell, each copy of Spinerock Tyrant triggers, copying Devastating Onslaught once for each Spinerock Tyrant and choosing the spell recursion creature once and Spinerock Tyrant as each additional spell's target.
Resolve all copies of that spell, creating two copies of the spell recursion creature and additional copies of Spinerock Tyrant.
When the first spell recursion creature token enters, it triggers, returning the spell that creates Treasure from your graveyard to your hand.
 When the second spell recursion creature token enters, it triggers, returning Devastating Onslaught from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat from step 7.
6785-7845--178--179.notes: The mana needed is calculated assuming you use a spell that costs 2 to cast and creates one Treasure token.

1458-3713--44.easyPrerequisites: Steelfin Whale does not have summoning sickness.
1458-3713--44.description:
Cast Banishing Knack by paying {U}, giving Steelfin Whale an activated ability until end of turn.
Activate Steelfin Whale by tapping it, returning the free artifact from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast that artifact by paying {0}.
When that artifact enters the battlefield, it triggers Steelfin Whale, untapping it.
Repeat from step 2.
1458-3713--44.notes: The Infinite (creature) ETB and LTB results only apply if the free artifact is a creature.

Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Shambling Ghast.
When Shambling Ghast dies, it triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}
Repeat.

457-1409-2471-7306.description:
Activate Zabaz by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
Zabaz leaves and reenters the battlefield, causing it to enter with a +1/+1 counter due to its modular ability, and triggering The Ooze and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability.
Resolve Deadeye Navigator's trigger, repairing it and Zabaz
Resolve The Ooze's trigger, creating a Mutagen token for each +1/+1 counter that was on Zabaz when it left the battlefield.
Activate Urza's first ability twice by tapping Zabaz and a Mutagen, adding {U}{U}.
Repeat.

215-3464-5614.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with power 5 or greater.

When Hyrax Tower Scout enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Bighorner Rancher.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Hyrax Tower Scout from the battlefield to your hand.

2146-3532-5078-7314.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Baxter triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

3713-4316-4474-5078.description:

Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.

When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Battered Golem triggers, untapping Battered Golem.

4002-4331-4908-4993.easyPrerequisites: You control three or more lands that share a name.

1497-2092-4289-5217.description:
Activate Order of Whiteclay by tapping it, adding {W}.
Activate Wild Cantor by sacrificing it, adding {W}.
Activate Order of Whiteclay by paying {W}{W} and untapping it, returning Wild Cantor from your graveyard to the battlefield.

Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.

1322-3204-4251-4364.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block and kill Aurelia.
Mysterious Limousine does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
One of Aurelia or Godo must be on the battlefield, with the other exiled by Mysterious Limousine.

Declare either Aurelia or Godo and Mysterious Limousine as attackers.
Mysterious Limousine and either Aurelia or Godo trigger.
Resolve the Aurelia or Godo trigger, untapping Mysterious Limousine and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Mysterious Limousine trigger, exiling Aurelia or Godo from the battlefield, and then returning Aurelia or Godo from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

465-643-1879-3742-4251.description:
Declare Phantom Steed and Godo as attackers, triggering each of their second abilities.
Resolve the Godo trigger, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.

When the token Wormfang Drake enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Godo.
At the end of your combat phase, Phantom Steed triggers, causing you to sacrifice the Wormfang Drake token.
When the token Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Godo from exile to the battlefield.
When Godo enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, allowing you to search your library for an Equipment card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

1479-3257-4677.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-3257-4677.description:
Play Rakdos Carnarium.
When Rakdos Carnarium enters the battlefield, it, Zendikar's Roil, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Rakdos Carnarium trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Zendikar's Roil trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Rakdos Carnarium from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Rakdos Carnarium enters the battlefield, it and Zendikar's Roil trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

307-1655-2792.notablePrerequisites:
Ninja of the Deep Hours and Great Whale do not have summoning sickness.
An opponent cannot block Ninja of the Deep Hours or Great Whale.
You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{U}{U}{U}.
307-1655-2792.description:
Declare Great Whale and Ninja of the Deep Hours as attackers.

Activate Thousand-Faced Shadow's ninjutsu ability by paying {2}{U}{U} and returning Ninja of the Deep Hours from the battlefield to your hand, putting Thousand-Faced Shadow onto the battlefield from your hand tapped and attacking.
When Thousand-Faced Shadow enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a token copy of Great Whale that is tapped and attacking.
When the Great Whale token enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
Activate Ninja of the Deep Hours's ninjutsu ability by paying {1}{U} and returning Thousand-Faced Shadow from the battlefield to your hand, putting Ninja of the Deep Hours onto the battlefield from your hand tapped and attacking.
Repeat from step 2.
Deal combat damage using the Great Whale tokens, dealing infinite combat damage to the defending opponent.
If you control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {4}{U}{U}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana.

884-1407-2615.notablePrerequisites: You do not control a Construct.
884-1407-2615.description:

When the Tree of Perdition token enters the battlefield, Ayara triggers.
Holding priority, activate the Tree of Perdition token by tapping it, swapping an opponent's life total with Tree of Perdition's toughness.
Resolve the Ayara trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
The opponent whose life total was swapped loses the game due to having zero or les life.

Activate Earthcraft by tapping the Saproling token, untapping a basic land.
Repeat.
